turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, Adrian Lim. Rachel Tan speaking. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or would you prefer that we arrange another time?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Now can, Rachel. I'm in the office with the door closed. Warehouse quite noisy outside, but here should be fine. Let me give you my particulars. [[EV_009]] [[EV_010]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. You mentioned wanting a brief discussion. I will keep the conversation focused and leave room for anything you want to raise. Has it been a busy morning at the business?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Busy as usual lah. Deliveries all arriving together, then customers call about their stock. Small things also come to me. My operations manager handles plenty already, but some decisions still land on my desk.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds demanding. For routine account updates, would you prefer a short message highlighting the administrative items, rather than a lengthy telephone conversation?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Short message better. Put the main point at the top, then any paperwork underneath. Long email I tend to leave until later, then it gets buried. If you need me to call, just say so clearly.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that communication preference. Turning to the candidates you reviewed, I will introduce them in sequence. [[EV_011]] [[EV_012]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've got the material open beside me. No need to run through the whole document again. What would you recommend?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we continue, I need to cover the disclosures. [[EV_001]] [[EV_002]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me shut the other screen. Staff messages keep popping up, very distracting. There, better already. You have my attention now.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your answer. There is no need to rush your wording while we are speaking.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have noted what you said. Before the final readback, is there an administrative matter you wanted to raise about receiving correspondence?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Use the usual secure inbox for the paperwork. My office email gets too much supplier mail. Easier to keep banking correspondence separate, otherwise later I spend ages searching.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will note your preference for the secure inbox. Please continue to use the bank's secure channels for any documents containing personal information.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's how I normally do it. My assistant sorts the business emails, but personal banking I handle myself. Less confusing like that.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we end the conversation, was there anything else you wanted to bring to my attention?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Actually, there's something I should mention. [[EV_008]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. I will refer what you have said to the appropriate team for review. I cannot give you a completion update at this stage.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: All right, I'll leave you to that. You can reach me through the usual channel if there's anything further.
